baseline_definition.dc05: greedy farthest-point direction sampling (seed = max-z light; add argmin max-dot to selected; ties -> lowest index); corruption-model-free, prediction-model-free
baseline_definition.comparability: Gardi 2022 (OED light-position optimization) and ReLeaPS 2023 (RL next-light selection) optimize different objectives (positions / sequences, not per-light calibration precision) -- not reimplemented; not numerically comparable. DC05 is the implementable same-lights geometry baseline.

oi_anchor: 88 informed rows BIT-IDENTICAL to the frozen E-arm anchor subset (shared orderings + seeds)
note: Literature-style selection baselines on the same light sets: geometry-only (DC05) vs the calibrated prediction model vs random, at the frozen E-arm operating point (level 0.5, regime 10, budgets 14/28), realized endpoint = normal angular error. OI cohort carries the full frame with a bit-identity anchor; DiLiGenT the minimal comparable trio.
